lines.H1: Investors poured billions into indoor farms. Many of the biggest went bust.
lines.B1: The real farm revolution is happening outside.
lines.B2: A U.S. robot spots weeds with A.I. and burns them with lasers. Up to ten thousand a minute, its maker says.
lines.B3: China now has over 300,000 farm drones.
lines.B4: In New Zealand, cows wear solar collars. Sound and vibration steer them. The fence is an app.
lines.B5: European satellites photograph every field on Earth every five days. For free.
lines.B6: Why now? About seventy percent of the fresh water we use goes to farming.
lines.B7: In Azerbaijan, over a third of all workers are in agriculture. So this is our future too.
lines.B8: Which one would you bring to your village first?
lines.H2: There's a robot that burns weeds with lasers. Up to ten thousand a minute.
lines.B1b: And that's just one of the technologies changing farming right now.
lines.H3: In New Zealand, some cows don't need fences anymore.
lines.B4s: They wear solar collars. Sound and vibration steer them. The fence is an app.
